expression_comparison.chosen_because: UST 2Y, AU 2Y, CA-US 5Y and AUDNZD are already historically extreme, the FOMC event has occurred, and NZ official rates are unavailable. Neither a fresh rates expression nor spot adds an uncrowded, executable edge.

considered_rates.assessment: US 10Y 4.94 is near the 1y 97.8th percentile with a 45.000000000000014bp 3m change; AU 2Y 4.835 sits at the 99.8th 1y percentile while Australian housing is tightening.
US 2s10s is 27.000000000000046bp at the 1.4th 1y percentile, so curve is an executable alternative to spot or outright duration.
CA-US 5Y is -122.00000000000001bp at the 0.2th 1y percentile — a historically extreme cross-market RV object.

considered_spot.assessment: Spot pitches recycle the same post-hike and housing headlines without a clean unused discrepancy.

remit: apparent edges are priced, too noisy, too crowded or poorly timed; may submit no-trade
stance_summary: The room's cleanest objects are already 98-99th percentile or missing NZ yields; no incremental trade clears the bar.
